name: wiwihaun-skills
description: Six skills for Claude Code: a free local YouTube-to-Traditional-Chinese transcript pipeline, a pre-build gate that pressure-tests a product idea before any code gets written, a market survey that turns competitors' documentation into a build spec, a stock valuation that writes down what has to be true for today's price, a wider-searching fork of find-skills, and a cover-letter writer that only uses résumé facts you have confirmed.

plugins.name: yt2script
plugins.description: YouTube link to a verbatim transcript in the language spoken (Chinese in Traditional characters, never translated). Human subtitles first, native auto-captions second, local Whisper large-v3 third. No API keys, no paid services, nothing leaves the machine except the audio fetch.

plugins.name: prebuild-gate
plugins.description: Gate a product idea before writing code: how it charges, and where the first paying customers come from. Researches what comparable products actually earn in the last 30 days and returns a go / no-go memo.

plugins.name: whatfunc
plugins.description: Survey the products that already exist in a category, extract each one's complete feature inventory, and write it up as a build spec with feasibility marks and a recommended build order.

plugins.name: find-skills
plugins.description: Find and install agent skills. Searches what is already installed on the machine and both on-disk catalogs before touching the network, and reports cost as two separate questions. A modified fork of vercel-labs/skills.

plugins.name: fairprice
plugins.description: Estimate what a stock is worth by writing down what has to be true for today's price to make sense. Picks between sum-of-the-parts, normalized earnings times one multiple, and finite-life NPV, then reports a bear/base/bull range with falsifiable checkpoints.

plugins.name: cover-letter-tailor
plugins.description: Merge every version of your résumé into one profile you have confirmed line by line, then turn a pasted job description into a requirements table, a fit verdict, a cover letter and a private gap report, using only facts from that profile. Conflicting dates, titles and numbers are asked, never picked.
